main_text.p: aliud de versione illa Samaritana judici-um tulit quàm antea. Interea Petrus à Valle scribit Morino,qvi sit gentis Sama-ritanæ in oriente status. Samaritanos scilicet hodiernis temporibus numero paucissimos esse,se aliqvot reperisse Cai-ri in Ægypto,Gazæ, Hierosolymis, Da-masci & in civitate Sichem, à Turcis Na-plus sive Neapolis nuncupata,qvæ nunc Samariæ Metropolis, eorum Synagogas extra civitatem inter hortos amœnissi-mos positas,qvæ viles qvidem extrinse-cus appareant, intus autem picturis & auro haud indecore ornatus esse,variis-q; inscriptionibus Lingua Samaritana infignitas. Miratus est Morinus,gentem Samaritanam in tam contemnenda pau-citate legis Mosaciæ exemplar, patrios mores,ritusq; suos conservare potuisse, de ista iterum qværit nonnulla ex Val-læo, qvæ rescire cupiebat; sed hæc peni-tus se ignorare liberè agnoscit Vallæus, qvippe qvi nihil omnino Lingvarum O-rientalium se scivisse profiteatur,cùm ad Samaritanos adiit. Non pauca tamen scripsit

page.notes: Long s is given as plain s throughout. Lingvarum, qvi and qvippe are printed as such, with u/v changed as the rule requires only for the vowel and consonant forms; the printed qv-spellings are kept in the -que abbreviations (q;). The page number is printed as "2ı" with a dotless i; given as 21. No doubtful readings on the text itself; the page is clean apart from scattered specks in the left margin.
